---
pagetitle: "Blog — Ho Chin Wei"
description-meta: "Personal blogs about my research in human-robot cognition."
toc: false

# blog/_metadata.yml sets these for the posts; the listing page is not a post.
title-block-banner: false
freeze: false

listing:
  # Every post is a folder next to this file with its own index.qmd. The "*/"
  # is what keeps this page out of its own listing - a bare "." or a recursive
  # glob would match index.qmd and list the blog inside itself.
  contents:
    - "*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  fields: [date, title, description, categories]
  categories: unnumbered
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  feed: true
---
